info.description: OpenAPI specification of the catalog microservice

cascade.description: If true, cascades deactivation to child categories

parentId.description: New parent category UUID, or null to move to root level

imageIds.description: Ids from POST /uploads/images, in display order (the first is the cover). Replaces `images` when sent.

attributeIds.description: Attributes this product varies on (ids from GET /attributes), in display order. Can also be set later with PUT /products/:id/attributes.

createDefaultVariant.description: If true, creates an initial default sellable variant in the same transaction

defaultSkuCode.description: Optional SKU code for the initial default variant

defaultBarcode.description: Optional barcode for the initial default variant

defaultBasePrice.description: Optional base price (whole VND) for the initial default variant

name.example: Áo thun cotton nam cao cấp

imageIds.description: Ids from POST /uploads/images, in display order (the first is the cover). Replaces `images` when sent.

version.description: Expected current aggregate version for optimistic concurrency control (409 on mismatch)

skuTokens.description: Optional map of attribute value text to custom SKU token (e.g. {"Black":"BLK","White":"WHT"})

conversionFactor.description: Positive conversion factor relative to product base unit

usedByVariants.description: How many variants of this product carry this value

values.description: Every value of the attribute in this store (the choices a variant form offers), not only the ones this product uses

attributeIds.description: The attributes this product varies on, in display order. Replaces the current list. An attribute that a variant of the product still uses cannot be left out (409).

uploadId.description: uploadId from POST /uploads/imports, content already PUT
